semantics.actionCardinality: exactly one component.command or event.emit action
semantics.guardOrdering: guard before discriminator and every action-specific observation

semantics.targetLiveness: zero or multiple instances unavailable; exactly one current generation dispatchable
semantics.registration: opaque factory ticket, monotonic generation, foreign/stale/ABA rejection, atomic lock
semantics.commandInput: canonical named materialization then exact component-command-input validation
semantics.hostEvents: exact name-to-contract allowlist, detached payload validation, then emission
semantics.portGrammar: receiver-independent own-data callbacks and closed synchronous redacted envelopes

semantics.callbackLifetime: current manager/snapshot rechecked after command, validation, emission, and diagnostics
semantics.finiteBounds: lower-only action, registration, snapshot, registry, allowlist, and identifier ceilings
semantics.snapshotReservation: each accepted live ticket reserves one later exact unregister transition
semantics.disposal: terminal minimal manager and ticket tombstones
